newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SKI JUMPING-GOLDBERGER QUITS AUSTRIAN SKI FEDERATION.
newsitem.headline: SKI JUMPING-GOLDBERGER QUITS AUSTRIAN SKI FEDERATION.

text.p: Andreas Goldberger, twice winner of ski jumping's overall World Cup, has resigned from the Austrian ski federation, Austrian state radio reported on Tuesday.
Last month the federation suspended Goldberger, the 1996 ski flying world champion, for six months for using cocaine. He was also fined 100,000 schillings ($8,390).
Goldberger has frequently indicated he may jump for another country.
